\label {sol: functor from a star vector space to selfadjoint elements}Let us first show that this is well-defined. Indeed, we need to show that $F(f)$ is a well-defined $\R$-linear map. This is just a computation:
\begin{align*}
\forall x \in \selfadjointpart{V}: \dual{f(x)} &= f(\dual{x})\\
                                               &= f(x).
\end{align*}
So, $f$ maps into $\selfadjointpart{W}$. The fact that it is an $\R$-linear map follows from the fact that real numbers are fixed under complex conjugation.
